results.title: Towards Simulation of CubeSat Operational Scenarios under a Cyber-Physical Systems View
results.abstract: In the development of academic CubeSat-based space missions, it is common to skip or rush many practices of the Systems Engineering Process due to time and cost constraints, which may lead to issues later on in the mission and failures. results.title: Team Xc: JPL's collaborative design team for exploring CubeSat, NanoSat, and SmallSat-based mission concepts
results.abstract: Recently there has been an increasing demand for a rapid mission concept generation capability for CubeSats, NanoSats, and SmallSats at JPL and in the broader community in the Concept Maturity Level (CML) 2–5 range.
